description: Two more grey whales have washed up in B.C., with researchers and experts both warning the province is on pace for a record breaking year.
title: Emaciated grey whales washing up on B.C. beaches 'canary in coal mine,' researcher warns

description: A B.C. non-profit that supports people with spinal injuries was forced to cancel a raffle for a pair of World Cup tickets after receiving a nine-page letter from FIFA's lawyers, accusing it of trademark infringement and ticket rule violations.
title: B.C. charity scraps World Cup ticket raffle after letter from FIFA lawyers

description: The Liberal government's one-time GST rebate top-up, announced earlier this year, is set to begin landing in some Canadians' banks accounts starting on Friday.
title: Government to begin paying out one-time GST credit top-up for eligible Canadians

description: Spanish hotel chain Meliá has joined a growing list of companies with a long-standing presence in Cuba that are withdrawing or limiting their operations on the island after the U.S. announced new sanctions while upholding an oil embargo.
title: Cuba's battered tourism sector takes another hit as Spain's Meliá shutters some hotels

description: Miss out snagging the Shane Hollander Team Canada fleece? You aren't alone. Within 10 minutes of its Tuesday 12 p.m. launch, the hotly anticipated fleece completely sold out, according to Canadian apparel brand Province of Canada.
title: Want the Heated Rivalry Team Canada fleece? Well, it's already sold out

description: A woman with worsening dementia was left in a home for a year after Social Development found it would not meet her safety needs, New Brunswick's seniors advocate says.
title: A woman died after wandering from home 12 times. N.B. seniors advocate says many 'saw it coming'

description: Survey suggests 21 per cent of surveyed respondents in Alberta used models like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude to get financial guidance. Experts say online sources are a good learning tool but warn they can have risks.
title: Albertans most likely in Canada to get financial advice from AI, social media, poll shows

description: The largest production ever to come to Prince Edward Island will begin this summer.
title: Spicy romance novel adaptation to be filmed in P.E.I. with $5M from province

description: The brutal murder of 18-year-old student Henry Nowak in southern England has ignited another volatile debate in the U.K. over race and what’s been described as “white grievance.” Despite pleas from Nowak's grieving family to prevent his death from sparking racial division, prominent far-right and populist figures have tried to exploit the tragedy.
title: How Britain’s far right hijacked the murder of Henry Nowak

description: The owners of a hotel chain who are appealing orders to pay more than $100,000 in owed wages to three foreign workers say they weren't even aware two of the workers were employed at one of the company's Manitoba hotels.
title: Owners ordered to pay $100K in wages say they didn't know foreign workers were employed at their hotel

description: A man from Okotoks, Alta., faces criminal charges after police say they found more than half a million child sexual exploitation photos and videos in his possession. It's one of the largest collections the Alberta child exploitation unit has ever encountered.
title: Alberta man charged after more than 500,000 child sexual exploitation photos, videos seized

description: All six of Ken Sim's ABC party members voted on Tuesday against acting on the findings of the Integrity Commissioner's investigation into Sim's actions against Councillor Sean Orr. The other four councillors, including Orr, voted for sanctioning Sim,
title: Vancouver council votes not to sanction mayor after investigation found he harassed councillor

description: Pelican Narrows declared a state of emergency in 2024 amid ongoing violence and has since enacted a series of measures aimed at reducing crime.
title: First Nation leaders speak about Pelican Narrows shooting, violence in northern Sask.

description: Just as Peter Ballantyne Cree Nation leaders were preparing to talk to the media early Wednesday afternoon, RCMP announced the suspect in custody has been released and confirmed there were no longer any suspects in custody in relation to Monday's shooting.
title: RCMP still looking for suspect in fatal Pelican Narrows shooting

description: Just as Peter Ballantyne Cree Nation leaders were preparing to talk to the media early Wednesday afternoon, RCMP announced the suspect in custody has been released and confirmed there were no longer any suspects in custody in relation to Monday's shooting.
title: 'We need immediate help': First Nation's leaders decry wave of violence, lack of action in Pelican Narrows

description: A long-awaited centralized daycare waitlist will make it easier for families to find suitable child care in Nova Scotia, officials with the Education Department said Wednesday. The province is in the early stages of building a new online portal set to launch in 2027.
title: N.S. to create centralized daycare waitlist to streamline search for child care

description: Alberta will start to roll out new drivers licences starting July 2 that will include an individual’s health card number, finally eliminating the paper cards that have been the bane of Albertans for decades.
title: Alberta to eliminate paper health cards, introduce integrated driver licenses July 2

description: Long before your feed told you what to listen to, Quebec culture had a different tastemaker: MusiquePlus. Well, music fans can rejoice now that the TV channel that helped launch the careers of many Quebec stars is being revived as a new kind of influencer on TikTok.
title: Nostalgia alert: MusiquePlus is relaunching on TikTok

description: Four migrants working as fruit pickers in slave-like conditions in southern Italy have been burned to death. The murder case is prompting fresh national soul searching over the exploitation of farm workers.
title: 4 migrant farm workers in Italy burned to death in car, according to survivor, police

description: South Park creators Matt Stone and Trey Park say they aren’t backing down from satirizing U.S. President Trump in the show’s upcoming season — even if, as they say, the latest group trying to censor them now “has a military.”
title: South Park creators remain defiant, promise more Trump takedowns in new season

description: The federal government says it will direct the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission to review its recent decision tripling streamers' financial contributions to domestic content.
title: Ottawa calls for review of CRTC decision on streamers' Cancon contributions

description: Grammy-winning R&B singer Peabo Bryson, the voice behind Disney film duets Beauty and the Beast with Céline Dion and Aladdin's A Whole New World with Regina Belle, has died. He was 75.
title: Céline Dion pays tribute to duet partner Peabo Bryson after R&B singer's death at 75

description: Hundreds gathered in Southampton, U.K., on Tuesday to protest over the death of 18-year-old student Henry Nowak. Police handcuffed Nowak after an incident where he was stabbed. His killer falsely accused him of a racist attack.
title: Protests erupt in U.K. after video released showing arrest of dying teen

description: The community of Saanich, B.C., has been told a man spent six years secretly filming hundreds of women and girls in public spaces and the private of their homes — but the vast majority of victims may still not know it happened to them.
title: Public left wondering if they could be among 652 victims of Saanich, B.C., voyeur

description: More than four months after pledging that emergency physicians would soon begin roles monitoring waiting room patients, the Alberta government’s promised triage liaison physicians aren’t yet on the job.
title: Still no triage liaison physicians in Alberta ERs, 4 months after province's pledge

description: Injuries to some of soccer's star players, including Lionel Messi, Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal, sparked concern ahead of the World Cup. All three have been included in their national team squads for the tournament in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, but others have not been so fortunate.
title: Messi, Mbappe, Yamal are all World Cup-bound after injury scares

description: For kids, they represent independence — the freedom of a first dollar spent. For adults, a fail-safe for the forgetful, where last-minute ingredients save a recipe. It feels like these shops are always there when needed, but the reality is that corner stores are disappearing from major cities.
title: Are community stores a thing of the past for Calgary — or is a renaissance around the corner?

description: When Asia Mills-Daniels receives her Grade 12 diploma this month she will be the first member of her family to graduate high school and a member of her high school’s first ever Grade 12 graduating class.
title: Regina alternative school graduates 1st class of Grade 12 students in its 53-year history

description: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew on speaking out against separatism, why he wants to ban social media for youth, and the need for nation building projects.
title: Wab Kinew takes on separatism and big-tech

description: Kuwait said Wednesday it had suspended commercial flights after an Iranian drone attack hit the country's airport, injuring a number of people hours after Iran and the United States traded missile strikes in the region.
title: Iranian drone attack hits Kuwait airport, causing injuries
Iranian drone attack on Kuwait's airport kills 1

description: AI-related layoffs are in full swing as tech companies invest in artificial intelligence agents they say will take over tasks traditionally done by humans. But a major AI infrastructure and software company says the agents fail to produce professionally acceptable work more than 19 times out of 20, and some analysts say the technology is overhyped and being using as an excuse for laying off workers.
title: AI agents lag far behind human workers. Why are tech companies laying off the humans?

description: Erin Brockovich, the renowned consumer advocate and environmental activist who inspired an Oscar-winning movie staring Julia Roberts, is now setting her sights on AI data centres with a new website that maps their growth across the U.S. and asks residents to report their concerns.
title: Erin Brockovich takes aim at rapid growth of AI data centres with new project

description: Squamish RCMP say they have recovered the bodies of two paddleboarders who fell into Browning Lake over the weekend. Family have since identified the paddleboarders as recently-married couple Genesis Jeru Bague and Mariz Bello.
title: Bodies of 2 paddleboarders who fell into B.C. lake have been recovered, RCMP say
